title: US equity markets close early at 1:00 p.m. ET — the day after Thanksgiving
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes; the page needs curl -L, and its holiday data is JSON-ish '"text":"..."' cells rather than HTML table markup) and parsed cell-by-cell by this session. The page states 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028'; its Thanksgiving Day row parses as ['Thursday, November 26***', 'Thursday, November 25***', 'Thursday, November 23***'] for 2026 / 2027 / 2028, and footnote *** reads verbatim: 'Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Friday, November 27, 2026, Friday, November 26, 2027, and Friday, November 24, 2028 (the day after Thanksgiving). NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m. All times are Eastern Time.' Filed estimate rather than confirmed because the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for an exchange operator's own hours page and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep.
notes: DISCOVERED during the japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2026-11-27 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05). This is the entry the japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2026-12-25 lane wrote and then DELETED on the same day: its Honest limits record that it found the NYSE 2026-12-24 half-day and 2026-12-25 closure as dated primary-sourced adjacencies, but that scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs's KINDS list had 'no slot for a trading-hours event', and it declined to take a schema decision in passing. That decision has since been made in practice by a third lane: good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26, filed the same day out of the opex-2027-03-19 sweep, carries a US trading-hours event as kind 'sector', impact low, symbols [], status estimate with a NEWS: source, and validates clean. This entry reuses that precedent exactly; no new kind is invented. Why the date earns a row: checked mechanically against every date field in src/domain/market-events/, 2026-11-27 is the ONLY tracked event date falling on an NYSE early close (three others fall on full closures: japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2026-12-25, japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2027-03-26 and good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26). The session is structurally thin from both ends: 2026-11-26 is a full NYSE closure for Thanksgiving, and the corridor around it is unusually dense — 2026-11-25 alone carries pce-2026-11-25 and gdp-q3-2026-second-2026-11-25, both high impact, plus beige-book-2026-11-25, while fomc-blackout-start-2026-11-28 opens the next day. Consequence recorded rather than traded: no US tape reaction should be read off 2026-11-27, which is why the japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2026-11-27 ledger scopes its attribution claims accordingly. Impact is LOW and symbols is empty: this is a market-structure fact that changes how other events are READ, not an event with its own directional content.
